assumptions: Each stained tube carries one fluorochrome and is brightest in its own detector.
limits: norm2Filter scatter gating (useNormFilt) is not ported.
bio.jane/contract.question: What spillover matrix do these compensation controls imply?

description: flowStats spillover() on single-stained control tubes and an unstained tube from the project: per tube the median (or mean, or density mode) of every detector, the unstained baseline subtracted, each stained tube matched to its channel (by name distance or tube order), each row divided by its own detector.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

fsc.description: forward scatter channel, left out of the matrix.

pattern.description: regular expression the detectors must match; empty for all.

ssc.description: side scatter channel, left out of the matrix.

stain_match.description: how tubes are matched to channels. Values: intensity (by name), ordered (in tube order).

statistic.description: the per-tube statistic. Values: median (median), mean (mean), mode (density mode).

tubes.description: the control FCS files in the project, by name or id, comma-separated, the unstained one included.

unstained.description: which of the tubes is unstained, by name or id.

name: estimate_spillover_from_controls

matrix.description: the spillover matrix, rows the stained channels, columns the detectors
